Overview

Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY) is a safe motherhood intervention under the National Health Mission (NHM). The scheme focuses on reducing maternal and infant mortality by promoting institutional delivery among pregnant women, especially those from Below Poverty Line (BPL) households and in states with low institutional delivery rates.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Pregnant women belonging to BPL families
  • Women aged 19 years and above
  • For the first two live births (in most states)
  • All pregnant women in the 10 low-performing states, subject to the age and birth limit conditions

Benefits

  • Cash assistance for institutional delivery in a government or accredited private health facility
  • Under the revised scheme, eligible women in rural areas receive higher cash benefit than urban areas
  • Free delivery and care at accredited facilities

How to Apply

  1. Visit your nearest government health facility or Accredited Social Health Activist (ASHA) worker
  2. Register your pregnancy at the facility
  3. Deliver at the health facility to receive the cash benefit
  4. The benefit is transferred directly or through the facility as per state procedure

Required Documents

  • BPL card or certificate (where applicable)
  • Aadhaar card of the beneficiary
  • Bank account details for direct benefit transfer
  • Pregnancy registration card / Mother and Child Protection Card

Important Links

For official details, visit the National Health Mission portal: nhm.gov.in (as per the official portal).

Overview

Stand-Up India Scheme was launched to promote entrepreneurship among women, Scheduled Castes (SC), and Scheduled Tribes (ST) by facilitating bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore for setting up greenfield enterprises. The scheme aims to boost economic empowerment and inclusive growth at the grassroots level.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Applicant must be a woman, or belong to SC or ST category
  • Age: 18 years and above
  • Enterprise must be a greenfield project (first-time venture) in manufacturing, services, or trading
  • At least 51% ownership and control of the enterprise must be with the eligible applicant

Benefits

  • Bank loan between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore for a greenfield enterprise
  • Composite loan covering term loan and working capital
  • Repayment up to 7 years (with initial moratorium as per RBI norms)
  • Margin money of 10% for the loan (15% for other categories, reduced where applicable)
  • Handholding support and guidance through designated nodal agencies

How to Apply

  1. Prepare a business plan for the proposed greenfield enterprise
  2. Apply online through the Stand-Up India portal
  3. Select a preferred bank branch and submit the application
  4. The bank appraises the proposal and sanctions the loan as per eligibility

Required Documents

  • Identity and address proof (Aadhaar, PAN)
  • Proof of eligibility category (caste certificate or women status)
  • Business plan / project report
  • Bank account details
  • Educational qualification certificates as applicable

Important Links

Official portal: standupmitra.in (as per the official portal).
meta_title: Stand-Up India Scheme: Loan up to ₹1 Crore for Women & SC/ST

Overview

Pradhan Mantri Rozgar Yojana (PMRY) was a centrally sponsored scheme launched in 1993 to provide employment to educated unemployed youth by promoting self-employment through industry, business, service, and farm sector ventures. It remains a reference scheme for youth entrepreneurship support in India.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Unemployed youth aged 18 to 40 years (as per original guidelines)
  • Minimum educational qualification: 8th standard pass (for general categories)
  • Resident of the local area for at least 3 years
  • Family income limits as prescribed under the scheme guidelines
  • Not a defaulter to any bank or financial institution

Benefits

  • Bank loan for setting up self-employment ventures
  • Subsidy support on the loan for eligible beneficiaries
  • Margin money assistance under the scheme norms

How to Apply

  1. Contact the nearest District Industries Centre (DIC) or lead bank branch
  2. Obtain the PMRY application form
  3. Submit the filled form with the project proposal
  4. Complete the loan formalities after sanction as per the scheme process

Required Documents

  • Proof of age and education qualification
  • Residence proof
  • Family income certificate
  • Project proposal for the venture

Important Links

Note: PMRY has been subsumed into broader entrepreneurship and skill development programs over the years. For current schemes, check the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises portal (as per the official portal).
meta_title: Pradhan Mantri Rozgar Yojana (PMRY): Eligibility and Benefits
meta_description: PM Rozgar Yojana promotes self-employment among educated unemployed youth with bank loans and subsidies. Know eligibility, benefits, and how to apply.

Overview

Atal Pension Yojana (APY) is a government-backed pension scheme primarily targeting workers in the unorganised sector. It provides a guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 on attaining the age of 60, depending on the contribution made. The scheme is administered by the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) and is open to all eligible Indian citizens.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Indian citizen aged between 18 and 40 years
  • Must have a savings bank account or post office savings account
  • Not a member of any statutory pension scheme (EPFO, NPS, etc.)
  • Co-applicant/spouse aged 18-40 years is also eligible to open a separate account

Benefits

  • Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 after age 60
  • Same pension for the spouse after the subscriber's death
  • On the death of both, the accumulated corpus is returned to the nominee
  • Government co-contribution for eligible subscribers (as per the applicable norms at enrolment)
  • Income tax benefits on contributions as per prevailing tax laws

How to Apply

  1. Visit any bank branch or post office that offers APY
  2. Fill the APY registration form
  3. Choose the desired monthly pension amount
  4. Link the Aadhaar and provide the bank account details
  5. Authorise auto-debit of monthly contributions from the account

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card
  • Bank passbook or account details
  • Mobile number linked to the account

Important Links

Official details: npscra.nsdl.co.in (as per the official portal).

Overview

National Pension Scheme (NPS) is a voluntary, long-term retirement savings scheme regulated by PFRDA, open to all Indian citizens. Subscribers contribute regularly to a pension account during their working life, and on retirement they can withdraw a part of the corpus as a lump sum and use the rest to buy an annuity for a regular monthly pension. NPS is one of the most flexible and low-cost retirement instruments in India.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Any Indian citizen aged between 18 and 70 years (as per current norms)
  • NRI and Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) are also eligible under specified conditions
  • Both salaried and self-employed individuals can join
  • Employer co-contribution is available for corporate subscribers

Benefits

  • Builds a retirement corpus through regular contributions
  • Choice of investment options: Active or Auto choice across equity, corporate bonds, and government securities
  • Partial withdrawal of up to 25% of own contributions for specified purposes after 3 years
  • Tax benefits under Section 80C and Section 80CCD of the Income Tax Act (as applicable)
  • Market-linked returns managed by registered pension fund managers

How to Apply

  1. Visit the official NPS portal or approach a Point of Presence (POP) like a bank
  2. Complete the subscriber registration form (for individual subscribers)
  3. Complete KYC with Aadhaar and PAN
  4. Choose the pension fund manager and investment option
  5. Start contributing through net banking or auto-debit

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card
  • PAN card
  • Bank account details
  • Photograph

Important Links

Official portal: npscra.nsdl.co.in (as per the official portal).

Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PM-GKAY) is a food security scheme that provides free food grains to eligible households. It was introduced as a relief measure to ensure that no family goes hungry, particularly during difficult economic conditions. The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution in partnership with state governments through the Public Distribution System (PDS).

Eligibility Criteria

  • Households covered under the National Food Security Act (NFSA) — Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Priority Household (PHH) categories
  • Ration card holders as identified by the state government
  • Beneficiaries must be listed in the PDS beneficiary database

Benefits

  • Free food grains (wheat and/or rice) distributed through ration shops
  • Top-up of free grains over and above the NFSA entitlement for eligible periods
  • Direct delivery through fair price shops using e-PoS devices

How to Apply

  1. Check your eligibility on the PDS beneficiary list
  2. Visit your designated fair price shop (ration shop) with your ration card
  3. Collect the free food grain entitlement
  4. In case of issues, contact the state food and civil supplies department

Required Documents

  • Ration card
  • Aadhaar card (where linked)

Important Links

For the latest status and beneficiary lists, visit the Department of Food and Public Distribution: dfpd.gov.in (as per the official portal).
meta_title: PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana: Free Ration, Eligibility, Benefits
meta_description: PM-GKAY provides free food grains to NFSA households through ration shops. Check eligibility, benefits, and how to get your free ration entitlement.

Overview

Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) is a flagship scheme that provides free Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) connections to women from Below Poverty Line (BPL) households. Launched by the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, the scheme aims to protect the health of women and children by providing them with clean cooking fuel, reducing indoor air pollution, and eliminating the need to rely on traditional biomass fuels.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Adult woman from a BPL household
  • Applicant must be 18 years or above
  • No existing LPG connection in the household under any name
  • Household must be identified through the SECC (Socio-Economic Caste Census) list or other eligible categories as per the scheme guidelines

Benefits

  • Free LPG connection in the name of the woman of the household
  • First refill and accessories are provided free of cost under the scheme (as per applicable norms)
  • Access to clean cooking fuel reduces health risks from smoke inhalation
  • EMI facility for subsequent refills through the Ujjwala Sahaj program where applicable

How to Apply

  1. Visit your nearest LPG distributor (Indane, HP Gas, or Bharat Gas)
  2. Submit the PMUY application form with the required documents
  3. The distributor verifies eligibility against the SECC list
  4. Connection is installed after verification and payment of any applicable security deposit (waived where covered)

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card
  • Bank account details (for DBT of subsidy, where applicable)
  • BPL ration card or SECC verification details
  • Photograph of the applicant

Important Links

Official details: pmuy.gov.in (as per the official portal).

Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) is a small deposit scheme of the Government of India, launched under the Beti Bachao Beti Padhao campaign. It is designed to secure the future of the girl child by enabling parents or guardians to open a savings account in her name. The scheme offers one of the highest interest rates among government small savings schemes, along with income tax benefits.

Eligibility Criteria

  • An Indian girl child below 10 years of age
  • Only one account per girl child
  • A parent or legal guardian can open the account on behalf of the girl
  • A maximum of two accounts per family (two girl children)

Benefits

  • Attractive interest rate, revised quarterly by the government (among the highest in small savings schemes)
  • Deposits can start from as low as ₹250 per financial year
  • Maximum deposit up to ₹1.5 lakh per financial year
  • Tax benefit under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act
  • Account matures 21 years from the date of opening, or on marriage of the girl after age 18
  • Partial withdrawal allowed for higher education after the girl attains 18 years

How to Apply

  1. Visit any post office or authorised commercial bank branch
  2. Fill the Sukanya Samriddhi account opening form
  3. Submit the girl child's birth certificate and guardian's identity documents
  4. Make the initial deposit (minimum ₹250)
  5. Deposits can be made for 15 years from account opening

Required Documents

  • Birth certificate of the girl child
  • Aadhaar of the guardian and girl (where available)
  • Guardian's identity and address proof
  • Photograph of the guardian

Important Links

Official details: indiapost.gov.in (as per the official portal).

Overview

Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP) is a national campaign of the Government of India aimed at addressing the declining child sex ratio and promoting the education and empowerment of the girl child. The campaign works through a convergence of schemes across education, health, and women empowerment, with a focus on awareness generation and welfare interventions at the district level.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Open to all citizens — the campaign is an awareness and convergence initiative rather than a direct benefit scheme
  • District-level interventions target girl child welfare, education, and protection
  • Families can benefit from linked schemes like Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana, Beti Bachao scholarships, and health schemes

Benefits

  • Improved access to education for girls through scholarships and enrolment drives
  • Awareness campaigns on the value of the girl child
  • Convergence with schemes like Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana, Kishori Shakti Yojana, and school enrolment programs
  • District-specific action plans under the Beti Bachao Beti Padhao program

How to Apply

  1. No direct application is needed — benefits flow through linked government schemes
  2. For scholarships, apply through the National Scholarship Portal
  3. For savings benefits, open a Sukanya Samriddhi account at a post office or bank
  4. For education benefits, enrol the girl child in a government school or Anganwadi

Required Documents

  • Depends on the linked scheme being availed
  • Generally: birth certificate, Aadhaar, bank account details

Important Links

Official details: wcd.nic.in (as per the official portal).
meta_title: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao: Campaign, Benefits, Linked Schemes
meta_description: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP) promotes girl child education and empowerment. Learn about the campaign, benefits, and linked schemes like Sukanya Samriddhi.

Overview

Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) is a maternity benefit program that provides cash assistance to pregnant and lactating women for their first living child. The scheme aims to compensate for wage loss during pregnancy and encourage institutional delivery and proper nutrition. It is implemented by the Ministry of Women and Child Development under the umbrella of the National Nutrition Mission (Poshan Abhiyaan).

Eligibility Criteria

  • Pregnant and lactating women who are Indian citizens
  • Applicable for the first living child of the family
  • Age: 18 years and above at the time of pregnancy
  • Woman must be registered at the Anganwadi Centre (AWC) or health facility
  • Excluded: women in regular government employment, or those covered under other maternity benefit laws (as per scheme norms)

Benefits

  • Cash benefit of ₹5,000 in instalments (as per the scheme guidelines)
  • Benefit is transferred directly to the beneficiary's bank account through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)
  • Conditional on early registration of pregnancy, institutional delivery, and child vaccination

How to Apply

  1. Register your pregnancy at the nearest Anganwadi Centre or health facility
  2. Fill the PMMVY application form (Form 1A or as per state process)
  3. Submit the form along with required documents to the Anganwadi worker
  4. The benefit is credited in instalments after verification at each stage

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card of the beneficiary
  • Bank account details (passbook)
  • Mother and Child Protection (MCP) card
  • Pregnancy registration certificate
  • Date of birth certificate of the child (after delivery)

Important Links

Official details: wcd.nic.in (as per the official portal).

Overview

Digital India Programme is a flagship initiative of the Government of India to transform the country into a digitally empowered society and knowledge economy. It focuses on digital infrastructure, digital literacy, and delivering government services digitally to every citizen. The programme connects multiple initiatives like BharatNet, DigiLocker, UMANG, Aadhaar-enabled services, and digital payments.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Open to all Indian citizens and residents
  • Different sub-initiatives have their own eligibility (e.g., DigiLocker requires an Aadhaar-linked mobile number)
  • Digital literacy programs target rural citizens and underserved groups

Benefits

  • Access to government services online through the UMANG app and portals
  • Digital documents through DigiLocker
  • Digital payments through UPI, BHIM, and RuPay
  • Broadband connectivity through BharatNet for rural areas
  • Digital literacy training under programs like the National Digital Literacy Mission

How to Apply

  1. Register for DigiLocker using your Aadhaar-linked mobile number
  2. Download the UMANG app for government services
  3. Enrol for digital literacy training at the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC)
  4. Use digital payment services via your bank's UPI or BHIM app

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card
  • Mobile number linked to Aadhaar
  • Bank account for digital payment services

Important Links

Official portal: digitalindia.gov.in (as per the official portal).
meta_title: Digital India Programme: Digital Infrastructure and Services
meta_description: Digital India is the government's flagship programme for digital infrastructure, literacy, and e-governance. Learn about DigiLocker, UMANG, and more.

Overview

Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM) is the Government of India's nationwide campaign to eliminate open defecation and improve solid waste management. The mission focuses on building household and community toilets, promoting hygiene behaviour, and ensuring scientific waste management. The current phase, Swachh Bharat Mission 2.0, continues the focus on sustainability of sanitation and management of solid and liquid waste.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Households without a toilet are eligible for Individual Household Latrine (IHHL) assistance under the mission
  • Community and public toilet facilities are provided in identified areas
  • Beneficiary identification follows the Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) and gram panchayat recommendations

Benefits

  • Financial assistance for construction of household toilets (as per state norms)
  • Improved health and dignity, especially for women and girls
  • Cleaner villages, cities, and public spaces
  • Community engagement through Swachhagrahis and village health committees

How to Apply

  1. Contact your Gram Panchayat or Municipal Corporation office
  2. Register as a beneficiary for toilet construction assistance
  3. The panchayat/urban local body verifies eligibility
  4. Assistance is provided on completion of the toilet as per the verification process

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card
  • Bank account details for benefit transfer
  • Proof of residence

Important Links

Official details: swachhbharatmission.gov.in (as per the official portal).
